name: JW.ORG
description: Browse and stream public JW.ORG videos as a Jellyfin Channel.
overview: Adds a JW.ORG Channel to Jellyfin. The plugin browses public JW.ORG video categories and streams selected MP4 files directly from JW CDN URLs without downloading media locally.

versions.changelog:
Microsoft.Extensions.Http was being bundled in the plugin zip,
conflicting with the server's own copies and breaking type identity
for IServiceCollection. Mark it PrivateAssets="all" so it is
compile-time only and the server-provided assembly is used at runtime.

Replace the comma-separated text field with a searchable dropdown
backed by the JW.ORG languages API (1,095 languages). Selected
languages appear as removable chips. Falls back gracefully to
manual code entry if the API is unreachable.
Initial release. Adds a JW.ORG Channel to Jellyfin for browsing and streaming public JW.ORG video content with multi-language support.
